column3: MT 46:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew; NKJV adds “A Psalm,” renders “On Alamoth, a song” as “A Song for Alamoth,” and “he is found exceedingly” as “A very present help.”
Close to the Hebrew; בְּהָמִיר (“changes”) is rendered “be removed,” and “into the heart of the seas” “into the midst of the sea.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “There is,” and מִשְׁכְּנֵי (“the dwellings”) is rendered “the tabernacle.”
Close to the Hebrew; “at the turning of the morning” is rendered “just at the break of dawn.”
Close to the Hebrew; עֲגָלוֹת (“wagons, carts”) is rendered “the chariot.”
Close to the Hebrew; הַרְפּוּ (“let go, cease”) is rendered “Be still.”
